transfer_to_number.name: transfer_to_number
transfer_to_number.description: Transfer a clearly safe green call, or a screened amber expected-delivery call from an approved supplier, only when the caller explicitly requests a person. Before invoking this tool, disclose exactly: 'Before I connect you, I’ll remain as a silent note-taking and security monitor for this conversation.' After invoking it, produce no further speech. Never transfer any call involving payment or refund changes, account access, remote-access software, passwords, MFA or verification codes, private records, or other social-engineering signals. Monitoring failure must never prevent this normal conference transfer.

transfers.condition: The caller has an ordinary low-risk request, or has provided a name, approved supplier company and expected-delivery reference; explicitly asks to speak with a person; has heard the monitored-handoff disclosure; and has not requested or mentioned payment changes, refunds, account access, remote-access software, passwords, MFA or verification codes, customer records, staff availability, or other sensitive information.
